proof_summary:
Take \(k=31\) and \(s=1\): the divisor sets of \(5\) and \(1829=31\cdot59\) give
\[\frac1{32}+\frac1{36}=\frac{17}{288}=\frac1{32}+\frac1{62}+\frac1{90}+\frac1{1860}.\]
Thus the two distinct positive inputs \(5\) and \(1829\) have equal sums (hence equal fractional parts), contradicting pairwise distinctness.
